lines.zh: : 那个……
: Yumi，你……有什么事吗？……

lines.en: : Sorry, lardass. Shower’s got a weight limit. I'm sure you understand.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，肥猪。淋浴间有体重限制。我想你懂的。

lines.en: : Think you’re gonna have to wait here until everyone else is done. Don't want the floors collapsing and all that shit.
lines.zh: : 你得在这儿等到其他人都洗完。可不想地板塌了什么的。

lines.en: : Do we...have to do this in here?...
lines.zh: : 我们……非得在这儿说这个吗？……

lines.en: : If I did something to offend you, I'm sorry...I just...really want to take a shower and-
lines.zh: : 如果我做了什么冒犯你的事，我很抱歉……我只是……真的很想洗个澡，然后——

lines.en: : You really think I'd be offended by something {i}you{/i} did? Who the fuck do you think you are?
lines.zh: : 你真以为你做什么能冒犯到我？你他妈以为{i}自己{/i}是谁？

lines.en: : No, better question- who the fuck do you think {i}I{/i} am? You ain't shit to me.
lines.zh: : 不，换个更好的问题——你他妈以为我是谁？你在{i}我{/i}眼里连个屁都不是。

lines.en: : So tell me fatass, why would I ever be offended by something {i}you{/i} say? Go on. Tell me to my face.
lines.zh: : 所以告诉我，肥婆，我为什么会因为{i}你{/i}说的什么话而觉得被冒犯？来啊。当面说给我听。

lines.en: : I don't have {i}anything{/i} to tell you at all! I really do just want to take a shower!
lines.zh: : 我根本没{i}什么{/i}要跟你说的！我真的只是想洗个澡！

lines.en: : Already told you, there's a limit to how much this floor can take. Gonna have to wait your turn.
lines.zh: : 说过了，这地板能承受的重量有限。你得排队等着。

lines.en: : Can you please just let me pass? I...won't even look at you if that will make you happy...
lines.zh: : 你能不能让我过去？我……只要你高兴，我连看都不看你一眼……

lines.en: : You sayin' you normally look at me, you fucking dyke? And here I was thinking your roommate was the only muffdiver we had in our class.
lines.zh: : 你是在说你平时会看我喽，你个死同性恋？我还以为我们班上的舔阴狂只有你室友一个呢。
: Yumi……求你了！

lines.en: : You wanna pass? Fine. I guess I can look the other way.
lines.zh: : 你想过去？行。我想我可以把头转过去。
: 不过我有个条件。
: 你、你想要什么？……

lines.en: : My wallet is in my bag, so...
lines.zh: : 我的钱包在包里，所以……

lines.en: : You saying I'm fuckin' poor, lardass? You think you're better than me?
lines.zh: : 你是在说我他妈穷吗，肥猪？你觉得自己比我高贵？
: 不，我只是——

lines.en: : I don’t need your fucking money, got it? That ain't what I'm askin' for.
lines.zh: : 我用不着你他妈的钱，懂吗？我要的不是那个。
: 那你要的{i}是{/i}什么——

lines.en: : You’re gonna have to hand over the towel.
lines.zh: : 你得把毛巾交出来。

lines.en: : But...this is the only one I-
lines.zh: : 可是……这是我唯一的一条——

lines.en: : Wow, I offer you a deal as simple as that and you've gotta fucking {i}think{/i} about it?
lines.zh: : 哇，我给了你这么简单的一个交易，你还得他妈{i}想{/i}半天？

lines.en: : What's the problem? You embarrassed about walkin' across the room naked? We're all girls, ain't we? We've all seen each other's tits before.
lines.zh: : 有什么问题？你不好意思光着身子穿过房间？我们不都是女生吗？谁的奶子没被别人看过。

lines.en: : To be fair, though, yours ain't exactly easy to miss.
lines.zh: : 不过说句公道话，你的确实在很难被忽略。

lines.en: : I just...normally keep mine on until I'm in the room...
lines.zh: : 我只是……平时都穿着，直到进了里面才脱……

lines.en: : How come? You self-conscious about all those rolls? Some people are into that shit, you know? Is it really that big of a deal?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你对自己那一圈圈的肉感到自卑？有人就好这口，你知道吗？这有什么大不了的？

lines.en: : Why do you even need my towel?...You already have one...
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么需要我的毛巾？……你自己不是有一条吗……

lines.en: : I do. Just this one’s kinda damp from dryin’ myself off.
lines.zh: : 我有。只是这条擦完身子有点湿。

lines.en: : Shovin' it back into my locker like this will just make it all mildewy and shit.
lines.zh: : 就这么塞回柜子里，会发霉什么的。
: 你明白的，对吧？

lines.en: : Cause if you don't, I've got no problem just taking it from you by force and gettin' the fuck out here. Ain't like you'd do anything about it, right?
lines.zh: : 因为你要是不明白，我也不介意直接动手从你身上抢过来，然后滚出去。反正你也不敢怎么样，对吧？
: Yumi……

lines.en: : Hey, freedom for a towel seems like a reasonable trade to me. Not sure what the issue is.
lines.zh: : 嘿，用一条毛巾换自由，在我看来是很合理的交易。不知道有什么问题。
: 你就不能……去问别人吗？……

lines.en: : I'm sure...someone must have a spare...
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定……总有人有多余的……

lines.en: : The fuck did you just say to me?
lines.zh: : 你他妈刚才跟我说什么？

lines.en: : Yumi? What’s going on out there?
lines.zh: : Yumi？外面出什么事了？

lines.en: : If I find out you're picking on fucking Futaba again, I swear to God!
lines.zh: : 要是让我发现你又在欺负 Futaba，我对天发誓！

lines.en: : Just havin' a chat, Chika. A nice, friendly chat.
lines.zh: : 只是聊两句而已，Chika。友好又亲切的聊天。
: {i}毛巾。现在。{/i}
: 我的可以吗？

lines.en: : Huh?...Is your {i}what{/i} okay? The fuck's goin' on here?
lines.zh: : 哈？……我的{i}什么{/i}可以？这他妈是怎么回事？

lines.en: : You said you needed a towel, right? I don’t mind lending you mine.
lines.zh: : 你说你需要一条毛巾，对吧？我不介意把我的借给你。

lines.en: : This one's actually brand new, so you won’t need to worry about the mildewy issue or...whatever it was you said you were worried about.
lines.zh: : 这条其实是全新的，所以你不用担心发霉的问题，或者……你刚才说担心的是什么来着。

lines.en: : You think it’s okay to just fuckin’ listen in on other people’s conversations?
lines.zh: : 你觉得偷听别人说话是件他妈无所谓的事？

lines.en: : It’s not my fault that the acoustics in this room are so good. It's not exactly like I was {i}trying{/i} to listen in.
lines.zh: : 这房间的隔音这么好，可不是我的错。我又不是{i}故意{/i}要听的。

lines.en: : You just...naturally talk loudly, I guess. And this sounded like a pretty big deal based on how mad you were a few seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 只是……你说话天生就大声，我想。而且听你几秒钟前那么火大，这听起来像是个挺大的事儿。
: Ayane……你不必……

lines.en: : Are you going to take it or not, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 你到底要不要，Yumi？

lines.en: : Also, why are you even standing around if you’ve already showered?
lines.zh: : 还有，你都洗完了还在这儿站着干什么？

lines.en: : Taking in the sights or something? I didn't realize you were into girls.
lines.zh: : 观赏风景什么的？我没想到你好这口。

lines.en: : What the fuck are you talking about, Blondie?! The hell would give you that idea?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈在说什么，金毛丫头？！你从哪儿得出那种结论的？！

lines.en: : I just figured that if you’ve already showered and didn’t want to leave that there's a chance you {i}might{/i} want to fuck girls or something.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，既然你已经洗完了却不想走，那就有{i}可能{/i}你是想跟女生做点什么之类的。

lines.en: : Which is totally fine! I think girls are cute too.
lines.zh: : 那完全没问题！我也觉得女生很可爱。

lines.en: : I don’t think I'd ever {i}do it{/i} with one...but hey! More power to you if that's your thing!
lines.zh: : 我不觉得自己会跟女生{i}做{/i}……不过嘿！如果那是你的爱好，我挺你！

lines.en: : I don’t wanna {i}do it{/i} with anybody!
lines.zh: : 我他妈谁都不想跟谁{i}做{/i}！
: 真的吗？连老师也不想？
: 尤其不想跟他妈的{i}老师！{/i}

lines.en: : Yumi, seriously! What are you getting so heated over out there?
lines.zh: : Yumi，说真的！你到底在外面因为什么火成这样？

lines.en: : I'll ask again...are you going take it? Or not?
lines.zh: : 我再问一次……你到底要不要？要不要？

lines.en: : I ain't a fuckin' lesbo, got it?
lines.zh: : 我才不是他妈的女同，懂吗？
: 懂了。

lines.en: : And here I was thinking I might actually get to use my karate for once.
lines.zh: : 我还以为我这次终于有机会用上我的空手道了呢。
: 你没事吧，Futaba？
: 你……是怎么做到的？
: 你什么意思？

lines.en: : How did you...stand up to her so easily?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么……那么轻易就顶撞她的？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I just did. I saw her being mean, so I decided to help.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我就是做了。我看到她在欺负人，就决定帮忙。

lines.en: : I...don’t really know what to say...
lines.zh: : 我……真不知道该说什么……

lines.en: : Well, you can thank me if you’d like! But you really don't have to since I would have done that either way.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你想谢我可以谢！不过你真的不必，因为我无论如何都会那么做。

lines.en: : Oh my god! I-I’m so sorry! I totally forgot to say that! Thank you so much!
lines.zh: : 天哪！我、我太抱歉了！我完全忘了说了！真的太谢谢你了！
: 没事，没事！

lines.en: : Just punch her in the face next time, though. I think you’d be able to take her. She seems like more bark than bite, if you catch my drift.
lines.zh: : 不过下次直接揍她脸。我觉得你能打得过她。她看起来叫得凶、咬不动，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: : I...don’t really think I’m much of a fighter...
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得自己是块打架的料……

lines.en: : And...I also don’t want to start any problems, so...
lines.zh: : 而且……我也不想惹麻烦，所以……

lines.en: : Hmm...Well, that’s okay too. Just try to be a little more confident, okay?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那也没关系。只是试着自信一点，好吗？

lines.en: : I'm pretty sure Yumi only picks on you because you never stand up for yourself.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定 Yumi 之所以挑你欺负，就是因为你从来不为自己出头。

lines.en: : I don't want to tell you how to live your life, but...try not to let her walk all over you. Got it?
lines.zh: : 我不想教你怎么做人，但是……尽量别让她这么骑在你头上。懂吗？
: 你不该被这样对待。
: 嗯……好……我……我尽量……

lines.en: : Thanks again, Ayane...I’m...really glad you stood up for me...
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢你，Ayane……我……真的很高兴你为我出头……

lines.en: : Any time! That’s what I’m here for.
lines.zh: : 随时乐意！我就是为此而存在的。

lines.en: : Now, if you'll please excuse me, I have to go find another towel!
lines.zh: : 那么，失陪了，我得去找另一条毛巾！
: 那……其实是我最后一条了。
